text: Figure 5.1: Overview of the example model The example consists of 2 Software Compositions : • Compo_AHB, with 3 Software Components : Anton, Hugo and Bernd • Compo_Host, with 2 Software Components : Claus and Celine Each of them have Providing and Requiring Ports, some of which are connected on T op-Level view. There are 2 Software Clusters : • SwClu_AHB, which contains Compo_AHB • SwClu_Host, which contains Compo_Host They are described separately , based on the neccessary System Elements. Of course, in a real system, a cluster would usually contain several Software Compositions .
